objective.policy_reduction: sum of selected token PPO terms divided by fixed_token_scale
objective.kl_reduction: sum of selected token sampled k3 terms divided by fixed_token_scale
objective.action_reduction: Mean over complete eligible focal actions after action-level IS weighting
objective.estimand: Selected-state focal-action Q_actor surrogate with fixed token scaling; at an exact on-policy anchor and without clipping/KL, a two-sample mean baseline gives one half of the focal expected-return gradient divided by the fixed scale
objective.limitation: Sequence TIS is truncated; sampled k3 is a fixed-data regularizer. Neither mode estimates an unbiased full-trajectory task gradient or exact current-policy KL.

interpretation: Action-mean normalization can reverse the expected terminal-return direction even at an exact on-policy anchor. Fixed scale corrects this particular estimand difference; it does not explain the recorded short-r1 loss increase or prove a real-model gain.
